gloss: to have a packed schedule; to be fully booked

definitions.gloss: to have a packed schedule; to be fully booked
definitions.explanation: Describes a state where one's schedule is so full that there is little or no free time. The verb 詰まる (to be packed, to be crammed) conveys the sense of being tightly filled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予定|よてい}が{詰|つ}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have a packed schedule this week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予定|よてい}が{詰|つ}まりやすい。
examples.english: The end of the year tends to get busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦びっしり→びっしり：05892_bisshiri⟧⟦{詰|つ}まっていて→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧、⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Next month my schedule is completely packed, and I have no time to rest.

notes:
A common expression combining ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧ (schedule, plans) with ⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧ (to be packed, to be jammed). Most often used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form (⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧) to describe a current state.

FORMS:
- {予定|よてい}が{詰|つ}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ — schedule is packed (most common form)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦びっしり→びっしり：05892_bisshiri⟧⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧ — schedule is crammed full (emphatic)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぎっしり→ぎっしり：05891_gisshiri⟧⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧ — schedule is tightly packed (emphatic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ — busy (more general, not specific to schedule)
- ⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱいだ — the schedule is full (more casual, uses loanword)
- ⟦{多忙|たぼう}を{極|きわ}める→多忙を極める：21307_tabouwokiwameru⟧ — to be extremely busy (very formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予定|よてい}が{詰|つ}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ — to have a full schedule
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦びっしり→びっしり：05892_bisshiri⟧ — packed with plans
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧ — to have plans/appointments
